description: The EPSG geodetic dataset provides definitions for thousands of Coordinate Reference Systems (CRS), together with parameter values for thousands of Coordinate Operations between various pairs of CRS. This module contains the SQL scripts for creating a local copy of EPSG geodetic dataset. EPSG is maintained by the IOGP Surveying & Positioning Committee and reproduced in this module with same content. See https://epsg.org/ for more information.
